metadata.title: प्रद्योत किशोर ने अपमान पर जवाब दिया | Pradyot Kishor Manikya Message to Tribals
metadata.description: The Vice President of BJP criticised TIPRA motha chief on the eve of voting in Tripura East. Maharani Kirti Debbarma is candidate form the constituency .  Pradyot Kishor Manikya has realised an audio message in reply to Pataal Kanya Jamatia, the BJP Vice President.
